articles.title: Spain's leader says Russia and Israel fueled Ceuta migrant crisis "disinformation" - CBS News
articles.description: Spain's Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez says "networks linked both to Russia and to Israel" helped spread rumors about immigration "to attack Europe and divide it."
